svg.text: How a claim becomes credible here

The methodology, drawn as the pipeline it actually is. The two stages most benchmark write-ups skip are the two carrying all the weight: reporting the failures as the headline, and diagnosing them until your own excuse is falsified.
Every range of random seeds is spent once and recorded. A seed that helped choose a value is never allowed to score it.
THE TWO STAGES MOST BENCHMARKS SKIP

svg.text: G2 is still red — so a fix was proposed. THE FORK:

g.text: Seed hygiene — every range spent once, and recorded
threshold and simulator calibration — in-sample, excluded everywhere
the pre-registered gate sweep, and every re-sweep since
1-D sensitivity curves and the 2-D interaction slab — chose 8 → 9
virgin-seed validation of the shipped configuration
calendar gaps and the delivery-health benchmark
school-week recall audit — 20261200 was burned on a smoke test,
deliberately, so that the measured block stayed untouched
the corroboration-floor falsification — the fork to the right
A seed that helped choose a value can never be used to score it. The two knobs the calendar fix introduced —
a 0.2 collapse ratio and a 7-day baseline — were fixed by spec before the first execution and never moved.
Determinism is what makes the comparisons legitimate rather than two unrelated runs: two consecutive sweeps
at the same tree fingerprint produced byte-identical results.json, and the pre-fix control arm reproduced its
1,689 alerts, 540 distinct students and all seven fire dates row for row.
The honest limit, stated in every report: these plateaus live in a simulator with a bimodal ability gap, and a
classroom is a continuum. The pilot and the live calibration remain the only external checks this project has.
All of it offline: 706 tests in ~5 s, $0, no network, no credentials — the suite is also a cost audit.
The fork — a proposal that died on its own protocol
only when the recency EMA and
The floor bought precision — 0.982 [0.962–0.992] — and paid for it in recall: 0.994 → 0.917 [0.884–0.941], with
ledger-complete recall collapsing to 16/40 seeds. Under the school calendar, 18 of 180 struggling students were
never detected within 42 days. The proposal's own cost model had predicted this exact failure mode in advance:
“a deferral inside a closing window can cost recall outright.” It did.
The shipped configuration is unchanged — still the one validated on 2026-08-20. Threshold-level guards are now
exhausted: two swept, one slab-confirmed, one falsified. The remaining fix is the estimator itself, and that is
Cost asymmetry decided it: a missed struggling child outweighs a spurious parent ping, so any guard that trades
recall for precision starts from a deficit. Pre-registered criteria made the negative result cheap, fast and undeniable —
the guard lived four hours from proposal to grave, and nothing about killing it was a matter of taste.
The eight pre-registered gates, and what each one did across three runs
one gate is red, and it stays red — moving it would have been the easy lie
every low-ability student is actually reached
no family doing nothing wrong is interrupted — 11 residual FPs, EMA cold start
no family is pinged twice about the same thing inside a week
quiet disengagement is caught, and only where it is real
the teacher note fires only in the section that has the cluster
every planted injection stopped before any model call
the four failures were the instrument, not the product — stage 5
a child clicking through is switched to open answers, not punished
No number here was chosen after seeing the result. The gates were committed to git before the first seed ran. The value was chosen on seeds that were never allowed to score it.
The score came from seeds no analysis had ever touched. And where that discipline produced a failure — G2, and the corroboration floor — the failure is what got published.
